source_findings.partition: Vertical wall partitions agent-left and goal-right; one initially locked yellow door blocks path.
source_findings.prerequisite: Original Door.toggle requires carrying matching key, locked door cannot be crossed; key must be picked up before unlocking and traversal.
source_findings.reward: Base env step initializes reward=0, pays reward only when moving forward onto goal.
source_findings.partial_observation: Public image (7x7x3 uint8) plus direction; exclude constant mission text for all tokenless arms.
source_findings.conclusion: Genuine multi-action prerequisite with goal-only reward; unlike former CausalGym one-step optimal source. This is code-inspection evidence, not sampled evaluation.

secondary.suitability: Exploration-depth supplementary, not primary causal prerequisite, because immediate transition/move-cost cues can reveal useful action direction.
